name: Armos
location: Photograph one of the animated statue guardians inside the Tower of the Gods.

name: Armos Knight
location: Photograph one in the Tower of the Gods or the Wind Temple — it hops toward Link and spits spikes from its mouth.

name: Boko Baba
location: Photograph one of the biting plant enemies in Forest Haven or the Forbidden Woods.

name: Bokoblin
location: Photograph any Bokoblin variant — a common enemy in Dragon Roost Cavern and several other dungeons.

name: ChuChu
location: Photograph any ChuChu variant (red, green, or blue) — found throughout dungeons and the Great Sea.

name: Floor Master
location: Photograph one as it emerges from the floor in the Earth Temple or the Forsaken Fortress.

name: Gyorg
location: Photograph the shark-like fin cutting through the water while sailing the Great Sea.

name: Kargorok
location: Photograph one of the flying enemies found in caves and around several islands — get close without provoking an attack.

name: Keese
location: Photograph any Keese variant, including Fire Keese — common bat enemies inside dungeons.

name: Magtail
location: Photograph one of the fire centipedes in Dragon Roost Cavern's warp-jar rooms.

name: Miniblin
location: Photograph any Miniblin variant — found on Outset Island's hilltop and several other islands.

name: Morth
location: Photograph one of the burrowing worm enemies in the Forbidden Woods' log pits.

name: Octorok
location: Photograph any Octorok variant — found in Forest Haven's waters and across the Great Sea.

name: Peahat
location: Photograph one of the spinning flower enemies in the Forbidden Woods or the Wind Temple.

name: Poe
location: Photograph any Poe variant inside the Earth Temple.

name: Rat
location: Photograph any Rat variant — found in the Forsaken Fortress and the submarine near Bomb Island.

name: Bubble
location: Photograph a Red or Blue Bubble inside the Tower of the Gods.

name: ReDead
location: Lure one out of its coffin in the Earth Temple and photograph it without letting it freeze Link.

name: Seahat
location: Photograph one of the flying jellyfish-like enemies from a distance while sailing the Great Sea.

name: Wizzrobe
location: Photograph any Wizzrobe variant (blue or red) — found on several islands and inside the Wind Temple.

name: Big Octo
location: Photograph a Big Octo out on the Great Sea before defeating every one on the map.
note: Missable — once every Big Octo has been defeated, the chance is gone for that save file.

name: Darknut
location: Photograph a fully armored Darknut inside the Tower of the Gods.

name: Darknut (shielded)
location: Photograph the shield-carrying Darknut variant inside the Earth Temple.

name: Mighty Darknut
location: Photograph one near the Master Sword pedestal or the stairs to Ganon's chamber inside Ganon's Tower.

name: Moblin
location: Photograph any Moblin variant — found on several islands, including the Earth Temple's first room.

name: Mothula
location: Photograph one during the descent into the Forbidden Woods' entrance cave, while it's stationary.

name: Stalfos
location: Photograph one in the Earth Temple or the Wind Temple's early rooms.
